author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Limbs twist
in trysts of
stolen bliss
History slips
on lips as we
sip from the sun

feet skitter
reality withers
scattered dreams gleam
in seams of time

Hips let loose
in obtuse orbits


Home in the heliosphere
centered in the one


coming undone
symbiosis in our
 flamboyance of  flow
never together, not alone

souls accrete
as feet seep into
sound that surrounds
beats reach to
one's bound
unlock the epoch
in songs of
paradox
from the Garden to the Greek.
As we seek the bliss of our pits

Home in our Heliosphere
